program.title: BEng in Computer Engineering
uncertain: The 'Elective(s)' group shows two credit requirements: 3 and 12. It is unclear if these are separate sub-requirements or a combined total. The 12-credit requirement appears tied to area courses with distribution rules, while the 3-credit requirement is for a general COMP/ELEC 2000-level or above elective. These may represent two distinct elective sub-groups, but the PDF structure does not clearly separate them. Human review is needed to confirm whether these should be split into two groups or treated as a single group with multiple components.

Several course entries in the elective area tables (e.g., COMP 4521, COMP 4531, COMP 4611, COMP 4651, ELEC 3210, ELEC 4210, ELEC 4220, ELEC 4320, ELEC 4420, ELEC 4810, ELEC 4820, ELEC 4830) appear in multiple areas. While the current extraction includes all such courses under each area they appear in, it is possible that some listings are duplicates or errors in the PDF. However, without explicit deduplication instructions, all occurrences are retained as per the source.

The course ISDN1002 has no credits listed in the PDF (blank cell). It is unclear if this is a zero-credit course or if the credit value is missing. It has been recorded as 0 credits based on the blank, but this may require confirmation.

In the Engineering Fundamental Course(s) group, the course SENG appears without a number (just 'SENG') in the course code column, with the description spanning multiple rows. It is unclear if this is a placeholder for any SENG course or a specific course code. It has been retained as 'SENG' with the full description as the name, but this may not be a valid course code and requires review.

The course MECH1907 appears to have a duplicated credit value in the PDF: '3 3'. This has been interpreted as 3 credits, but the duplication may indicate a typo or formatting error. Human review is recommended to confirm the correct credit value.

total_required_credits (24.0) is a computed value: the sum of the required_credits of all groups in this file. The PDF does not state a single overall minimum total for this program, so this figure is derived by summation and may double-count where optional tracks/options are listed as separate groups.
